summary: IDxcCursor (include/dxc/dxcisense.h) still has no GetNumTemplateArguments/GetTemplateArgumentKind/GetTemplateArgumentValue-style methods; only generic GetNumArguments/GetArgumentAt (wrapping clang_Cursor_getNumArguments/getArgument) and a name-formatting flag exist. The underlying clang_Cursor_getNumTemplateArguments family already exists in this fork's libclang (CXCursor.cpp) but is still the pre-D134416 form gated to CXCursor_FunctionDecl via FunctionTemplateSpecializationInfo, so it would not by itself serve a class-template cursor like the reporter's Foo<float,-2,3> even if wired to IDxcCursor. git log of both dxcisense.h and CXCursor.cpp shows no template-argument-querying change was ever made. Matches maintainer llvm-beanz's 2023-07-13 comment: low priority, patches welcome.
title: IDxcCursor does not support template parameter and template argument querying
